summary.text: Ryan Hamilton is a Democratic state representative from the 15th Essex District who has served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works in government administration and holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Lowell.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Hamilton earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Lowell in 2021.
He took office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Linda Dean Campbell.
He serves on the House Committee on Ways and Means and on the Joint Committees on Election Laws, Financial Services, Labor and Workforce Development, and Ways and Means.
